articles.chapeau: "We’re just days away from beginning to see the fruits of our labor," says Strauss Zelnick who promises more sales details "post-launch."
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is about nine days away from launch, and it almost doesn’t feel real. That notion could also apply to its pre-sales, with Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick telling Variety that they’re “running far in excess of our expectations.
“That’s a good thing.” However, he reiterated the same belief that he’s said several times before. “We never claim success before it occurs. So we’re just days away from beginning to see the fruits of our labor.”
Players (and shareholders) won’t have to wait long to learn about it either, as the publisher will “certainly be giving more information about how GTA 6 performs post-launch.” Whether that’s on the same day or with its next financial results remains to be seen, but it’s expected to do big business.
The latest estimates from Sensor Tower claim that 7.71 million copies have been sold , allegedly generating $751 million in revenue. About 74 percent of sales are allegedly on PS5, which is good news for Sony given its partnership with Rockstar Games. Neither the developer nor Take-Two has confirmed the budget, especially after UK public records claimed it was over $2 billion . However, with a map triple the size of Red Dead Redemption 2 and a team that’s doubled since the latter’s release , it should certainly rank among the most expensive titles of all time.
Grand Theft Auto 6 retails for $80, with the $100 Ultimate Edition providing exclusive access to multiple stores and other benefits. Of course, you can always upgrade later, even with “physical” copies. Head here for more details.

But with preloads opening and the game demanding up to 212 GB of storage, launch day is already exposing hardware bottlenecks for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S owners.
Since Rockstar has skipped physical game discs entirely, shipping boxed editions as digital download codes, every single player will be pulling this colossal install through a network connection.
To ensure you aren't stranded staring at error codes, download pauses, or an overheated machine, here are the five essential checks to run on your console right now.
A 212 GB install means most players will need to make some tough sacrifices. Before opening your wallet, start with a thorough clear-out: head into your console’s storage manager to purge games you haven't touched in months, lingering DLC add-ons, and video captures quietly eating up dozens of gigabytes.
If you already own an external USB drive, you can temporarily offload old titles there as a "cold storage" archive, but current-gen performance demands mean you cannot play GTA 6 directly from an external USB port.
If deleting your backlog still doesn't free up enough space, upgrading your high-speed storage is your only remaining option:
Xbox Series X|S: Slot an official storage card like the WD Expansion directly into the port on the back.
PlayStation 5: Install an approved internal M.2 NVMe SSD into the expansion bay beneath the faceplates.
Preload timing varies significantly between platforms, with release windows shaped by whether your console operates on a unified global rollout or a regional schedule:
Xbox Series X|S: Preloading unlocks simultaneously worldwide, going live first in the US on Monday, November 9 at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT (which corresponds to midnight GMT on Tuesday, November 10 for UK players).
PlayStation 5: Downloads roll out on a strict regional basis, u nlocking at midnight local time on Tuesday, November 10 across each player's respective time zone globally.
If you opted for a physical boxed edition, keep in mind that these packages rely entirely on an enclosed digital voucher rather than a physical disc. These boxed versions will not arrive on store shelves until Thursday, November 12.
While players with digital pre-orders get a two-day head start over physical buyers to clear that massive 212 GB download, physical buyers will still have a full week to download the files before servers officially open on launch day.
Nothing kills download momentum like an unexpected system lockout. If an essential operating system update is pending, your console will pause your queue and cut off background network services until it is installed.
Power up your console manually ahead of launch day, check for any pending firmware updates, and install them so your machine is clear to download uninterrupted:
Xbox Series X|S: Press the Xbox button on your controller to open the guide, then navigate to Profile & system, Settings, System, and Updates. If your console is fully up to date, you won't see an available update.
PlayStation 5: Head to Settings, System, System Software, System Software Update and Settings, and run any pending updates.
Both consoles can quietly pull down the entire 212 GB package overnight, but only if your standby settings actually allow it:
Xbox Series X|S: Check Settings, General, and Power options. While the default "Shutdown (energy saving)" mode allows basic auto-updates, switching your power mode to Sleep ensures an uninterrupted network connection so queued preloads won't stall overnight.
PlayStation 5: Head to Settings, System, Power Saving, and Features Available in Rest Mode. Ensure Stay Connected to the Internet and Enable Turning On PS5 from Network are toggled on, then check under Settings, Saved Data and Game

The long wait for Grand Theft Auto VI is almost over. Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 preloading begins November 10, allowing PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S players to download the game ahead of its November 19, 2026, release.
However, players will need plenty of free storage. Rockstar says GTA 6 requires up to 212GB of available space, depending on the console. That’s a considerable download, particularly for anyone with a packed game library or a slower internet connection.
The good news is that digital preloading has been moved forward by two days from Rockstar’s original schedule. However, PlayStation and Xbox players have different download start times, and completing the preload won’t grant early access to Vice City.
According to Rockstar Games’ official preload FAQ , digital preloading begins Tuesday, November 10, 2026, with slightly different schedules for each platform.
This means Xbox players in the US can begin downloading GTA 6 on Monday evening, while PlayStation owners must wait until midnight in their respective time zones.
Rockstar initially scheduled digital preloading for November 12 when preorders opened in June. Its updated November 3 announcement moved the date to November 10, giving players nine days to prepare for launch.
The earlier download window is welcome news, especially considering the game’s substantial storage requirement.
Rockstar has officially confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI requires up to 212GB of available storage on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The actual installation size may differ between platforms. PlayStation specifically recommends clearing at least 212GB before starting the download.

For players who haven’t expanded their console storage, installing GTA 6 could mean deleting several existing games. It’s also worth checking the available space before enabling automatic downloads to avoid an interrupted installation.

During Take-Two Interactive’s November 9 earnings announcement , CEO Strauss Zelnick reaffirmed that the GTA 6 launch was ten days away. He also reported unprecedented preorder demand, although the company did not disclose specific preorder figures.
That confirmation comes after the game’s previous delays, including its move from May 26 to November 19, 2026.
With preloading now underway and Rockstar’s launch preparations continuing, GTA 6 is approaching its scheduled release.

Make sure automatic downloads are enabled and that your console remains connected to the internet. Downloads can continue while the PS5 is in Rest Mode if the appropriate settings are enabled.
On Xbox Series X|S , players should ensure automatic updates are enabled. Leaving the console powered on or in Sleep mode allows downloads to continue in the background.

articles.txt:
( NewsNation ) — Gamers are now one step closer to playing the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI.
Rockstar announced that gamers can preload GTA 6 on PlayStation and Xbox consoles starting Tuesday, ahead of the planned Thursday, Nov. 19 release date, in what could be the biggest entertainment launch of all time.
Fans have waited 13 years for the next open-world game in the long-running franchise. Gamers will be able to explore the fictional state of Leonida—based on the very real Florida—as Bonnie-and-Clyde-inspired Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.
Gamers itching to play GTA 6 will have to clear up a lot of space on their video game consoles due to its massive file size.
Last week, Rockstar shared that the game takes up 212 GB of console space, which is larger than most AAA games.
Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to be a very immersive experience, including the ability to build a romantic relationship with your partner, hurricanes and deeper experiences with NPCs.

The wait for Grand Theft Auto 6 is almost over, and excitement is reaching another level as players begin preparing their consoles for launch. A recent PS5 preload experience has revealed a download size of around 200GB, several additional content packs, and intriguing technical clues hidden in the game files. Meanwhile, the familiar New Zealand account method is once again attracting attention from players hoping to access the game as soon as its regional release begins.
One of the biggest talking points is the amount of storage required for GTA 6. In the reported PS5 preload, the full game appeared alongside several additional downloads, including the Vintage Vice City Pack and an Ultimate Edition upgrade.
The total download size shown was approximately 200GB, making GTA 6 a particularly demanding installation for console players. The preload process also displayed multiple extra add-ons, suggesting that the game may include several separate content components.

The large file size is not entirely surprising given the scale of GTA 6. Its detailed environments, expansive world, character animations, audio, and other assets may all contribute to the substantial storage requirement. With so much of Vice City waiting to be explored, players will also be curious about the activities, businesses, and financial opportunities that shape the experience. Naturally, the in-game economy and the ways players can build up their GTA 6 Money will be another interesting part of the adventure.
For players planning to install the game, checking available PS5 storage ahead of launch is a sensible step. A download of this size could be inconvenient for anyone who waits until release day to prepare their console.
Beyond the preload itself, players have reportedly started examining GTA 6's download files for technical clues. One discovery attracting attention is a reference to 120Hz support.
However, this detail needs to be interpreted carefully. A 120Hz display signal does not automatically mean GTA 6 will run at 120 FPS. Instead, the discovery has led to speculation that the game could potentially offer a 40 FPS mode on compatible displays.
A move from 30 FPS to 40 FPS might provide a noticeably smoother experience while maintaining a balance between visual quality and performance. Whether Rockstar will actually include such an option remains unconfirmed.
The reported findings have also raised interest in a newer version of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) for PS5 Pro.
PSSR is Sony's AI-powered upscaling technology. It allows a game to render at a lower internal resolution before using image reconstruction to produce a sharper final picture. If GTA 6 takes advantage of an improved version, PS5 Pro players could potentially benefit from clearer visuals without requiring the game to render every frame at native high resolution.
These file discoveries are exciting, but they should not be treated as confirmation of the final performance modes. Players will need to wait for official information and hands-on testing.
Another major topic is the use of New Zealand PlayStation accounts to access GTA 6 when the game becomes available in that region.
This method has been used by console players for years, particularly when major releases become available at different local times. New Zealand reaches midnight earlier than many parts of the United States, allowing players to access region-specific releases sooner according to the local launch schedule.

Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has been asked whether the next Grand Theft Auto will take as long as GTA 6, and while he didn't put a timeline on GTA 7, he says the way GTA content is delivered will change over the next decade.

VIEW GALLERY - 3 IMAGES The comments come from an interview Zelnick gave IGN alongside Take-Two's second quarter fiscal 2027 earnings, where IGN pointed to a Bloomberg feature in which Rockstar's heads of development said the studio's next game won't take another eight years to make. Zelnick was posed a similar question and said that " the nature and velocity of the content we'll see from our iconic franchises, including GTA, will look dramatically different over the next decade. "
What is interesting is how Zelnick specifically included GTA within this, indicating the time between GTA titles is now going to be shorter than the time between GTA 5 and GTA 6. So, does this mean GTA 7 is coming relatively soon? Not exactly. Zelnick never named GTA 7 or gave a release window, as " velocity of the content " could just as easily mean more frequent updates and online content as it could a faster sequel.

Notably, the Take-Two boss tied the shift to delivering high quality entertainment, reaching players in new ways, and keeping them engaged after launch. A prime example is GTA Online, which is still continuing to receive substantial updates 13 years after launch.

For anyone who has already pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI , it's about to take up a huge amount of space on your console's hard drive in the very near future.
That's because it's almost time to preload the most anticipated game of the year. If you don't normally engage with games this way, it means that anyone who has purchased GTA 6 will be able to install the full game on their hard drive before release. According to Rockstar , preloading will work slightly differently on PS5 and Xbox consoles. For PS5 owners, preloading will begin on Tuesday, Nov. 10 at midnight local time wherever you are. For Xbox players, preloading starts at 12 a.m. GMT on Tuesday and runs simultaneously for everyone.
To be clear, preloading the game early does not mean you can play it early, unless you set your console to New Zealand time . It will be locked and unplayable until it's officially out in your region.
Rockstar also confirmed in that post that the game will take up to 212GB of space on your hard drive, so start deleting games right now if you need to.

If you’ve ever spent hours cruising around Vice City in a stolen supercar , the kind folks over at Rockstar Games have found a way to bring that experience into the real world! Well, minus the hijacking, drive-bys and stunt bonuses of course. A real-life Grotti Cheetah from Grand Theft Auto 6 is currently on display at Selfridges in London, and it could be yours for a cool £1 million (roughly AUD $1.94 million).
The custom sports car was created by Rockstar Games in collaboration with West Coast Customs, the famous Los Angeles workshop best known for its work on Pimp My Ride . It’s one of six GTA -inspired vehicles the company has brought to life, although the Cheetah is the only one currently confirmed for sale.
It’s all part of a rather elaborate GTA VI takeover of Selfridges’ Corner Shop , where Rockstar has transformed the London department store into a slice of Vice City, complete with exclusive clothing, collectibles and plenty of fictional brands made real.

The low-slung supercar wears a striking blue-to-pink paint job, which West Coast Customs has dubbed the ‘Vice City fade’, alongside lowered suspension, track-ready tyres and a custom-stitched Italian leather interior. If you want more supercar action, our very own Ben McKimm got a chance to review the 2026 Ferrari 849 Testarossa back in October, calling it a “brutal antidote to delicate supercars”.

Alongside the $2 million Cheetah, there’s the Albany Buccaneer lowrider, Progen Emerus, Invetero Coquette, Albany Manana and Pegassi Tempesta police car. Each has received its own custom paintwork, mechanical specifications and interior treatment.

Photograph: Rockstar Games Crime pays: how Grand Theft Auto became a cultural colossus Ever since it crashed on to PC and consoles in the late 90s, GTA has been tearing up the game-making rulebook. We explore how its cultural references, rebel spirit and sprawling sense of freedom make it a definitive work of art
I n the 00s, when the Grand Theft Auto developer Rockstar Games revealed a new project, video game writers from all over the UK would make the journey to the company’s office in London. They would be ushered one by one into a darkened room to sit facing an enormous TV. There would be a dish of sweets on a low bench in front of them but, in the reverential hush that descended, it was never entirely clear if it was acceptable to eat them.
After a few moments, the screen would come to life. Rockstar would sometimes begin its presentation not with footage from its new game, but clips from classic movies. This is the context of what we are making, Rockstar was saying, and that is where we belong.
Yet, what’s interesting is that the studio’s ambitions were already straining against its cinematic influences. A cowboy adventure such as Red Dead Redemption might start with curated moments from spaghetti westerns – but the game itself would be eager to evoke everything from Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid to Warlock (the 1958 revisionist Old West novel by Oakley Hall) and the paintings of Frederic Remington.
Rockstar has since grown in stature so much that its newest game, Grand Theft Auto VI , had its first in-depth reveal in a Netflix special, with the added cachet of making Netflix’s own servers shudder a little on launch day.
So many video games deserve a place in the wider culture of the age from which they came. What are the 1980s without Pac-Man and Tetris? But with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI this November, Rockstar finds itself in unprecedented territory. The numbers alone are dizzying. Grand Theft Auto V, which launched in 2013, has sold more than 230m copies, and GTA VI is said to have cost more than $1bn to make.
This is surely the biggest video game release of all time – one that has sent rival games rushing to find other street dates, and sent ripples through the rest of the media (and beyond). That raises a few questions. How did Rockstar get to this point with a game that initially explored the simple pleasures of running people over? What are the cultural touchstones ensuring GTA continues to fascinate so many people, regardless of whether they’ve ever picked up a game controller? And when it comes to art , where does GTA belong?
T he first Grand Theft Auto was made by the Scottish developer DMA Design in 1997. Players would race around a series of fake US cities, stealing cars and colliding with pedestrians. The action was viewed from a top-down perspective and the tone was high-spirited, befitting a design heavily inspired by the penny victories of pinball.
Speaking to the Guardian in 2015 , Paul Farley, one of the game’s designers, explained that there was no budget for a fact-finding trip to the US, and there was only one PC with internet access in the whole studio. “We’d come in on a Monday and say: ‘What movies did you watch at the weekend? What music are you listening to?’” Nonetheless, what can now be seen as the GTA experience was already starting to form. Here was a game offering freedom, a heightened sense of place, and sharp stabs of dark humour. The cars that players could steal had names such as Impaler and Mundano, reminiscent of the Culprits, Autocrats and Fiascos parked outside hotels in Martin Amis’ novel Money. Amis was already a useful reference in broader ways, too. As one online commentator said, Amis deals in “great ugliness described with surprising beauty”. That certainly sounds like GTA.

Le PlayStation Store Révèle Trois Entrées Multijoueur Pour GTA 6, Sans Annonce De Rockstar
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 affiche 3 entrées liées au multijoueur dans les données du PlayStation Store. Des indices techniques qui ne prouvent pas la présence d'un mode en ligne.
articles.txt:
Trois entrées techniques suffisent à relancer les spéculations sur la prochaine escapade en ligne de Rockstar. Leur présence dans les données de Sony renseigne toutefois davantage sur les interactions avec la console que sur un contenu jouable.
Le compte PlayStation Game Size , qui exploite les données internes du PlayStation Store, a relevé trois entrées associées à GTA 6 sur PS5 : « joinSession », « launchActivity » et « launchMultiplayerActivity ». Il les a publiées le 9 novembre , peu avant l’ouverture des préchargements, prévue le 10 novembre.
Le compte a ensuite partagé une capture de la file de téléchargement PS5 où « Story » apparaît comme un composant distinct. De quoi alimenter l’hypothèse, chez les joueurs, d’un futur mode en ligne proposé sous forme d’installation séparée. Cette organisation du téléchargement ne suffit cependant pas à établir les plans de Rockstar.
Ces relevés ont un précédent assez précis : PlayStation Game Size avait estimé le téléchargement à 210 Go , avant que Rockstar confirme un besoin de stockage pouvant atteindre 212 Go . La fiabilité des données collectées ne garantit pas pour autant l’interprétation qu’on leur prête.
Les trois entrées semblent correspondre à des fonctions standard de la PS5, permettant à l’interface de lancer directement une activité ou de rejoindre la session d’un ami. Rien dans les éléments partagés ne démontre la présence de contenu multijoueur . Rockstar présente toujours GTA 6 comme une expérience solo et n’a annoncé aucun mode en ligne.
Une suite à GTA Online reste néanmoins envisagée. Dan Clancy, PDG de Twitch, a déclaré plus tôt dans l’année s’attendre à un lancement du multijoueur de GTA 6 en 2027 , après avoir discuté avec Rockstar de ses projets. Il s’agit de son estimation, pas d’un calendrier annoncé par le studio.
Take-Two a par ailleurs indiqué que le GTA Online actuel continuerait à être pris en charge après la sortie de GTA 6. Pour les joueurs, le maintien de ce service est donc un engagement plus concret que les indices techniques découverts sur le PlayStation Store.

articles.t: GTA 6 Preorders Beat Forecasts as NBA 2K27 Falls Short
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 preorders are tracking far above Take-Two's plan before the Nov 19 launch, while NBA 2K27 missed its forecast. What the Q2 numbers mean for you.
articles.txt:
Take-Two says GTA 6 preorders far exceed its plan 10 days before the Nov 19 launch, but net bookings fell 18% to $1.6B as NBA 2K27 missed. Here's why.
Take-Two Interactive says GTA 6 preorders are "tracking far in excess of our initial expectations," ten days before Grand Theft Auto VI launches on November 19, 2026. The publisher shared the update with its fiscal second quarter results on November 9, but it did not give a single preorder number.
The same report shows the other side of a GTA year. NBA 2K27 sold more than 4 million copies and still missed Take-Two's forecast, and CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 itself is part of the reason.
Strong enough for Take-Two to use very big words. In the official earnings release , Zelnick said, "The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company."
On the earnings call he added that "the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough." That is a polite way of saying the real figures come after launch. GTA VI arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Take-Two's lineup table still lists no PC version. If you have not set up your console yet, our GTA 6 preload guide covers start times and the 212GB download.
NBA 2K27 came out on September 4 and posted the second best net bookings in the series' history. Net bookings is Take-Two's main sales measure: everything it sold digitally or shipped to stores in the period. Even so, the game landed below the company's own target.
Zelnick told IGN, in comments reported by Kotaku , "It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer." In other words, some players may be saving their money for Vice City. He was relaxed about it with Bloomberg: "If your lunch is going to be eaten, I'd rather be the one eating it." President Karl Slatoff was more careful on the call, saying "it's really hard to know exactly" why the game fell short.
The quarter ended on September 30, so it contains no GTA VI sales at all. Recurrent consumer spending, meaning money players spend inside games they already own (virtual currency, add-ons and in-game purchases), fell 9%. Take-Two had guided for a 5% drop.
Net bookings also missed Take-Two's own range of $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion, and Bloomberg says Wall Street expected about $1.65 billion. The full year outlook of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion stayed the same, and the October to December quarter alone is guided at $3.35 billion to $3.50 billion. GamesIndustry.biz notes that operating costs should rise about 21% in that quarter, mostly because of GTA 6 marketing.
Mostly, it suggests November 19 is holding. Take-Two repeated its $8 billion forecast and its launch date ten days out, with no hint of another delay. Rockstar's older game is still a giant too: GTA V has sold nearly 235 million copies, and the GTA+ membership grew by double digits last quarter.
Expect heavy server traffic and a crowded launch week, much like the pressure Sony pointed to when it discussed falling PS5 sales ahead of GTA 6 . PS5 Pro owners also have something to look forward to, since a datamine points to a 120Hz mode for GTA 6 .
A publisher calling its own preorders "unprecedented" is not proof, so the real test is the first sales figure after launch. Still, the NBA 2K27 miss tells us something useful: GTA 6 is pulling money out of gamers' wallets before it even ships. For Take-Two, a weak quarter is the price of one of the biggest game launches ever, and it looks happy to pay it.

articles.t: GTA 6 Festival Miami: Lottery Closes 4 p.m. ET [2026]
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 Festival in Miami on Nov. 21: DICE lottery closes 4 p.m. ET today, winners at 7 p.m., sale Nov. 11. Lineup, rules, what is unknown.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games will stage a live music event in Miami on November 21, 2026, and the window to enter for tickets closes today. TechRadar reported that Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival will run at Mana Wynwood, with access handled through a pre-sale lottery on the DICE ticketing platform. Entries close at 4 p.m. ET on November 10.
That deadline lands in a busy week for the franchise. Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled for November 19, 2026, which puts the GTA 6 Festival two days after the game ships. Our earlier look at the GTA 6 preload and release setup covers the console side of launch week. This piece covers the live side, and the clock is short.
Below, we lay out what Rockstar and the outlets covering the announcement have confirmed, what remains unannounced, and how the lottery works hour by hour. We also look at why a publisher would stage a one-day concert for a video game, what it signals for Take-Two, and where the real risks sit for fans trying to get in. One caution up front: entering the lottery does not guarantee you a ticket.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The event carries the full name Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, and Rockstar Games is the organizer. It takes place on a single day, November 21, 2026, at Mana Wynwood in Miami, Florida. According to the reporting, the format is a one-day live music event with two stages. That is the entire confirmed shape of the show so far.
Four performers have been named. NME reported the lineup as Travis Scott, Cardi B and Justice, with Don Toliver completing the announced group. SPIN ran its own report framing the festival around Travis Scott, Don Toliver and Justice. Taken together, the outlets agree on four names: Travis Scott, Cardi B, Don Toliver and Justice.
GamesRadar treated the announcement as another oversized swing from a studio known for them, and the framing fits. Rockstar has built its marketing around spectacle for years. A ticketed festival for a game that has not yet launched pushes that habit out of the screen and into a physical venue. Few publishers attempt it, and fewer still pair it with an entry system this restrictive.
We have kept this section deliberately narrow. Rockstar has not published set times, a stage schedule or a full run of show in the material we reviewed. Anything beyond the venue, date, format and four names would be guesswork, so we are not offering it.
Three timestamps govern the whole process, and all three fall inside a 20-hour stretch. The lottery closes at 4 p.m. ET on November 10. Winners are selected at 7 p.m. ET the same day. Selected entrants can buy tickets starting at 12 p.m. ET on November 11. Miss the first window and the other two never apply to you.

Several outlets, including Forbes , framed the lottery as the real gate to the event. Forbes pointed out that money alone will not get a fan through the door, because the lottery decides who gets the chance to pay in the first place. That reading matches the structure Rockstar has confirmed.
The practical advice is simple. Enter now, and enter only through the official route that Rockstar’s announcement points to. Every outlet we reviewed describes the same gate, a pre-sale lottery run through DICE. We are not reproducing form fields or screen layouts here because we have not verified them, and a wrong detail could send someone down a bad path under deadline pressure.
Check three things first. Confirm that you are 17 or older, since that is the age floor for both attendees and lottery entrants. Decide whether you want one ticket or two, because a winning code or purchaser can buy up to two. articles.t: GTA VI : Le pré-téléchargement est disponible sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S | Rockstar Actu
articles.chapeau: Le pré-téléchargement de GTA VI est ouvert sur PS5 et XBOX Series X|S. Horaires, espace de stockage nécessaire : tout savoir pour être prêt le 19 novembre.
articles.txt:
En attendant la sortie officielle de GTA VI le jeudi de la semaine prochaine, le 19 novembre, les futurs joueurs du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games peuvent à présent le pré-télécharger sur PlayStation 5 et XBOX Series X|S.
À noter que cette installation ne permet pas de lancer Grand Theft Auto VI avant le 19 novembre à minuit, heure locale, moment à partir duquel les joueurs pourront enfin y jouer. Ce téléchargement anticipé permet simplement d’accéder au jeu dès les premières secondes de sa commercialisation, sans avoir à attendre cette date pour commencer à l’installer.
Les joueurs PlayStation peuvent allumer leur PS5 pour lancer l’installation de GTA 6, disponible depuis minuit en France métropolitaine. Les Calédoniens pouvaient déjà y accéder depuis quelques heures, puisque Sony a lancé le pré-téléchargement à minuit, heure locale. Cela signifie que les joueurs québécois ou guadeloupéens devront, eux, patienter encore quelques heures.
Le jeu pèse un total de 209,75 Go sur PS5. Il faudra donc prévoir beaucoup d’espace de stockage libre, sans compter qu’il ne serait pas surprenant que de futures mises à jour finissent par alourdir la taille du jeu.
Le pré-téléchargement est également disponible du côté de XBOX depuis quelques minutes. Il a été ouvert simultanément dans toutes les régions du monde, à minuit heure de Londres (soit 1 h du matin en métropole), contrairement à Sony, qui a opté pour un déploiement à minuit, heure locale.
Pour les joueurs XBOX, GTA VI pèse 209,86 Go sur Series X|S, un poids un peu plus élevé que sur la console concurrente. Cela peut potentiellement s’expliquer par la prise en charge des technologies Dolby Atmos et Dolby Vision, qui sont exclusives à la console de Microsoft.
Le Dolby Atmos est une technologie qui permet d’obtenir un son en 3D : les sons émis en jeu, qu’ils se trouvent au-dessus du joueur ou sur les côtés, seront retransmis fidèlement, aussi bien sur le plan horizontal que vertical.
L’édition physique de GTA VI, dont la boîte contient un code et non le disque du jeu, sera distribuée à partir de ce jeudi 12 novembre. Rockstar Games a choisi de la faire livrer en avance afin de permettre aux joueurs d’installer le jeu pour qu’ils puissent y jouer dès les premières secondes du lancement.
À noter que les joueurs XBOX qui ont précommandé l’édition physique peuvent dès à présent pré-télécharger GTA VI, sans avoir à attendre jeudi. Pour ce faire, ils doivent se rendre sur l’application mobile XBOX, puis rechercher le jeu dans le store. Ils pourront alors lancer le téléchargement depuis l’application, comme pour n’importe quel autre jeu, sans avoir à posséder la licence. Il faudra cependant saisir le code présent dans la boîte pour obtenir la licence pour y jouer le 19 novembre.
Jaquette de GTA 6 avec la « fille » en bas à gauche qui est présente sur le poster à l’intérieur de la version physique Certaines boutiques de jeux vidéo ont déjà reçu leurs exemplaires et ont déballé quelques boîtes pour découvrir leur contenu. Comme déjà évoqué, l’habituelle carte du jeu n’est pas présente dans l’édition physique, sans doute pour éviter tout spoil, puisque celle-ci est expédiée une semaine avant la sortie.
Bonne nouvelle cependant : un poster est bien présent dans la version physique. Il représente la « fille » de la jaquette, comme il est coutume au dos de la carte dans les précédents opus de la saga Grand Theft Auto.

articles.t: Physical GTA 6 Xbox case leak reveals possible advantages over PS5 version
articles.chapeau: A retail packaging leak indicates GTA 6 supports Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos on Xbox consoles. Dolby Vision can produce more accurate colors than the PS5’s HDR10. PlayStation systems output Atmos signals over HDMI, but rely on Tempest 3D for spatial audio.
articles.txt:
Sony has advertised PS5 consoles as the best way to play Rockstar’s new title . Some owners of Microsoft’s gaming systems have felt overlooked as the marketing campaign unfolded. Still, a leak of the physical case confirms the GTA 6 Xbox version has exclusive visual and sound perks.
Ahead of the November 19th GTA 6 release date , images of the PS5 retail box already spread on social media. Instead of a map, Rockstar enclosed a double-sided poster. Now, videotech has shared the back of the Xbox case, which reveals details on compatible video and audio formats.
Series X and S loyalists should expect Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos as options. Dolby Vision can have advantages over HDR with dynamic metadata optimized for specific scenes. The result is more accurate colors and brightness levels in games and movies.
Frustratingly for home theater enthusiasts, Xbox consoles offer Dolby Vision, but rival PS5 hardware does not. PlayStation fans rely on the still-very-capable HDR10 . Regardless, OLED TV brands like Sony and LG promote Dolby Vision as a selling point.
Although much of the focus has been on graphics, cinematic Rockstar projects also have immersive sound. The physical GTA 6 Xbox case explains that Dolby Atmos spatial audio will be available on Microsoft’s systems. Games using the technology produce precise positional effects reflecting the on-screen action.
By popular request, the PS5 added Dolby Atmos support in a September 2023 update. Even so, games are calibrated for Sony’s Tempest 3D audio first, before it's translated to Atmos. The end product varies and can be just as impressive, if not superior. Nevertheless, many listeners prefer the alternative in surround sound setups with height speakers.
Revelations about the GTA 6 Xbox version are unlikely to change the reported large gap in pre-order sales . Preload leaks hint the PS5 Pro will provide a higher frame rate or refresh rate. Otherwise, analysts anticipate performance on the Series X and base PS5 console to be comparable.

articles.t: À Quelques Jours De Sa Sortie, GTA VI Dépasse Largement Les Attentes De Son éditeur
articles.chapeau: GTA VI dépasse les attentes de Take-Two avant sa sortie. Fin octobre 2026, ses précommandes numériques étaient estimées à 6,45 millions dans le monde entier.
articles.txt:
Les réservations s’accumulent plus vite que ne l’avait prévu Take-Two Interactive. Son PDG, Strauss Zelnick, se garde pourtant de crier victoire avant que les joueurs aient le jeu entre les mains.
Interrogé par Variety à quelques jours du lancement, Strauss Zelnick affirme que les précommandes de Grand Theft Auto VI sont « très largement supérieures à nos attentes » . Il ne fournit toutefois ni volume actualisé ni objectif interne permettant de mesurer cet écart.
« C’est une bonne chose. Cela dit, nous ne revendiquons jamais un succès avant qu’il ne se produise », précise le dirigeant. Il ajoute que l’entreprise n’est plus qu’à quelques jours de commencer à voir « les fruits de notre travail » et communiquera davantage d’informations sur les performances du titre après sa sortie.
L’attente était pourtant déjà considérable avant même l’annonce de la date de sortie. Certains analystes estimaient que le jeu pourrait générer jusqu’à 4,5 milliards de dollars de ventes dès sa première semaine . Cette projection reste distincte des prévisions internes évoquées par Zelnick.
Fin octobre 2026, les précommandes numériques étaient estimées à 6,45 millions d’exemplaires dans le monde , dont 74 % auprès des acheteurs PlayStation. Ce décompte estimatif ne constitue donc pas un nouveau bilan officiel livré par Take-Two.
La répartition entre éditions apporte un autre éclairage. Dans un entretien accordé en août, Strauss Zelnick avait confirmé que les précommandes de l’Ultimate Edition, proposée à 100 dollars, soit environ 90 euros à titre indicatif, dépassaient celles de l’édition standard. Ce constat valait à cette date, sans nouvelle ventilation communiquée depuis dans les éléments rapportés.
Le volume vendu ne sera donc pas le seul indicateur à surveiller au lancement : le poids de l’Ultimate Edition peut aussi peser sur les recettes. Reste à connaître la répartition finale des achats pour confronter les premières performances commerciales aux projections des analystes.

articles.t: Le préchargement de GTA 6 est disponible : comment télécharger le jeu en avance ?
articles.chapeau: Le moment est presque arrivé. Treize longues années après la sortie du cinquième épisode, GTA 6 est enfin à nos portes et sera disponible dès [...]
articles.txt:
Le moment est presque arrivé. Treize longues années après la sortie du cinquième épisode, GTA 6 est enfin à nos portes et sera disponible dès la semaine prochaine. Mais dès maintenant, vous pouvez prendre un peu d’avance en téléchargeant le jeu. Le préchargement de GTA 6 est ouvert depuis minuit sur PS5, et à partir de 1 h du matin sur Xbox Series X|S.
Comment télécharger en avance GTA 6 ? Comme Rockstar l’a indiqué, vous pouvez dès à présent prétélécharger GTA 6 si vous avez précommandé le jeu sur le PlayStation Store (sur PS5) ou sur le Microsoft Store (sur Xbox Series) . Pour cela, il suffit de vous rendre sur la fiche du jeu sur la boutique en question et de télécharger le jeu une fois précommandé. Enfin, c’est presque l’heure, car si le préchargement de GTA 6 est bien actif ce mardi 10 novembre à minuit sur PS5, les possesseurs de Xbox Series doivent attendre 1 heure du matin pour commencer le téléchargement.
Si vous avez précommandé l’édition physique de GTA 6 , l’histoire est un peu différente. Ces dernières sont normalement expédiées en avance par la plupart des boutiques. Si certains clients annoncent sur les réseaux sociaux être déjà en possession de la version boîte du jeu, la plupart des commandes devraient arriver dès le 12 novembre prochain, selon le revendeur. Cette édition physique ne comprend pas de disque mais un code de téléchargement, qui va vous permettre de l’installer sur votre console dès que vous le recevrez.
Pour télécharger GTA 6 sur votre console, vous aurez besoin d’environ 212 Go sur votre PS5 ou votre Xbox Series.
Le préchargement ne fonctionne que si GTA 6 est déjà lié à votre compte, par une précommande sur le PlayStation Store ou par le code d’une version en boîte.
Pour lancer le téléchargement sans attendre devant la console, activez les téléchargements automatiques et laissez la PS5 connectée à Internet en mode repos (Paramètres, Système, Économie d’énergie, Fonctions disponibles en mode repos).
Sur Xbox, le jeu doit apparaître dans votre collection, après une précommande sur le Microsoft Store ou l’utilisation d’un code.
La console télécharge aussi en veille si l’option d’alimentation Veille est activée et si la mise à jour automatique des jeux est cochée.

La boîte de GTA 6 ne contient pas de disque, mais un code de téléchargement . Les revendeurs annoncent des livraisons et des retraits à partir du jeudi 12 novembre 2026 .
Le code est lié au compte qui l’utilise : sur une console partagée, mieux vaut donc l’activer sur le compte principal.

articles.t: GTA 6 : vous pouvez dès maintenant télécharger le jeu sur votre PS5
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 est désormais disponible en téléchargement sur PS5 et Xbox Series.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 débarque officiellement le 19 novembre, soit jeudi de la semaine prochaine. Pour ceux qui l’ont déjà acheté, il est possible de le télécharger dès maintenant sur leur PS5 ou Xbox Series. Un départ anticipé pensé pour éviter la saturation des serveurs, mais aussi pour que tout le monde puisse disposer du jeu au moment fatidique, même ceux avec une connexion peu performante. Une fois GTA 6 installé, il est évidemment impossible de le lancer. L’écran de démarrage va donc vous narguer pendant une longue semaine.
Attention, à l’heure de la publication de cet article (mardi 10 novembre à minuit), seule la version PS5 est disponible. Pour la version Xbox, il faut attendre une heure du matin (téléchargement disponible à minuit, mais heure GMT). Un peu de patience ! Si ce n’est pas déjà fait, faites un peu de place sur le SSD de votre machine. GTA 6 est en effet un jeu massif. Très massif. Il pèse 212 Go, un record sur consoles !
À l’origine, la date du téléchargement avait été fixée au 12 novembre par Rockstar. Elle a finalement été avancée au 10 novembre, soit aujourd’hui. Une manière de contrôler totalement le lancement et d’éviter ainsi le risque de voir des petits malins y jouer avant tout le monde grâce à une version physique. Cependant, cette méthode pose aussi la question de la préservation de l’œuvre, ainsi que celle de savoir qui la détient réellement : le joueur… ou Rockstar ? Pour rappel, GTA 6 prendra place à Vice City, un pastiche de Miami. Comme d’habitude, le joueur pourra s’y balader librement, accomplir des missions ou s’amuser avec des activités annexes. Le titre met en scène un couple de braqueurs, Jason et Lucia, qui doit trouver son chemin dans le monde du crime. On peut s’attendre à ce qu’ils rencontrent tout un tas de personnages hauts en couleur. GTA 6 est plus qu’un jeu vidéo : c’est un événement culturel qui va marquer durablement l’année. GTA 6 | Des précommandes largement au dessus des attentes, Take Two est confiant et de gros changements à venir chez Rockstar Games
articles.chapeau: Au cours d'un entretien avec IGN et Variety, Strauss Zelnick a donné pas mal de détails autour de la sortie et du lancement de GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Ce soir se tenait le nouveau call avec les investisseurs de Take Two Interactive. En parallèle, le PDG de l’entreprise, Strauss Zelnick, s’est entretenu avec IGN et Variety pour donner plus de détails autour du lancement imminent de GTA 6.
Nous sommes à six petits jours de la sortie de GTA 6 . Désormais, c’est plus réel que jamais. Ce soir se tenait le dernier call avec les investisseurs avant la sortie du titre. L’occasion pour S.Zelnick d’effectuer une ultime sortie et nous donner les derniers détails en interne.
Si cet été, Take Two restait assez modeste, affirmant seulement que les précommandes étaient au-dessus des attentes, mais que le lancement était encore loin… Ce soir, S.Zelnick s’est montré bien plus confiant. Au cours d’un entretien avec IGN , le PDG de la maison mère de Rockstar Games a affirmé que les précommandes étaient bien au delà des attentes et que, pour ceux qui pourraient encore en doute, les chiffres parleront bientôt d’eux-mêmes .
« Les précommandes pour Grand Theft Auto VI dépassent de loin nos attentes initiales, et nous savons que les chiffres parleront d’eux-mêmes sous peu. »
L’objectif principal de Take Two et SOURCE est de s’assurer que le jeu soit lancé dans des conditions optimales pour les joueurs . S.Zelnick évoque ici les potentiels soucis de serveurs. On le sait, Rockstar a fait le choix d’un lancement par région , ce qui signifie que GTA 6 sortira à minuit, heure locale dans chaque pays, et non à la même heure partout dans le monde. C’est sans doute pour éviter des surcharges de serveurs et des plantages au moment du lancement du jeu.
« Nous sommes très concentrés là-dessus et nous avons l’intention de faire de notre mieux pour offrir une expérience de livraison fluide à tous nos clients. »
S.Zelnick semble plus confiant que jamais . Il a confirmé être optimiste et, quand le journaliste d’ IGN lui a demandé ce qu’il ressentait, après plus de dix ans de productions, deux reports et pas mal de péripéties, Zelnick a affirmé qu’il attendait « avec impatience le lancement » .
Les autres sujets assez bouillants de la soirée, c’est la sortie de GTA 6 sur PC , mais également d’une vraie version disque . D’autres espèrent une version Switch 2 . À ce jour, à dix jours de la sortie, aucune des deux versions n’est confirmée par Rockstar Games . Hélas, ce ne sera pas pour ce soir non plus. Dans un entretien accordé à Variety , S.Zelnick a confirmé que ce genre de décisions appartient toujours à leurs labels et que, de ce fait, Take Two laisse ses studios réaliser ce genre d’annonces eux-mêmes. La balle est donc entre les mains de Rockstar .
L’autre point important de ces entretiens avec IGN et Varitety , c’est concernant l’avenir de la firme étoilée. Le mois dernier, Rob Nelson confirmait déjà que le prochain jeu Rockstar arriverait bien plus vite que GTA 6 (par rapport à Red Dead Redemption II , sorti en 2018). Les prochains jeux Rockstar ne mettront donc pas huit ans à sortir. Au cours de l’échange avec IGN , S.Zelnick semble clairement aller dans ce sens, expliquant que le contenu lié aux licences de Rockstar Games , dont GTA , devrait connaître des changements radicaux .
« Chacun de nos trois labels a sa propre stratégie et son approche spécifiques, et je les soutiens pleinement. Nous sommes convaincus que la nature et le rythme de diffusion des contenus issus de nos franchises emblématiques, dont GTA, connaîtront des changements radicaux au cours de la prochaine décennie. Cette évolution est directement liée à notre engagement, qui fait de nous un acteur majeur du secteur, à proposer des divertissements de la plus haute qualité, à toucher nos joueurs de manière inédite et dans de nouveaux lieux, et à maintenir leur engagement après le lancement ».
Tout semble être prêt du côté de Take Two , avec une certaine confiance. Désormais, il n’y a plus qu’à patienter, mais nous avons terriblement hâte.
P our ne rien manquer de l’actualité de Rockstar Games, rejoignez Rockstar Mag’ sur YouTube , X (Twitter) , Threads , Instagram , Facebook , Discord et Bluesky .

articles.txt:
Rockstar Games is one day from opening downloads for Grand Theft Auto VI . Pre-loading begins November 10, 2026, and the game launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Coverage from Cinelinx and Nintendo Life has framed the run-up as the build toward the biggest release in entertainment history, a label the publisher itself has not claimed.
That gap between headline and record book is the real story today. The confirmed facts are strong on their own: a $79.99 standard edition, pre-orders that opened at midnight local time on June 25, 2026, and a physical edition that ships as a download code with no disc. Our earlier look at the install-size claims circulating before preload showed how quickly unverified numbers spread when a release gets this big.
This analysis separates what Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar have actually confirmed from what the market is projecting. It covers the timeline, the price, the packaging, the money at stake for Sony and Microsoft, and four predictions for launch week. Anything the official sources do not state stays marked as unconfirmed.

Start with the short list of facts that hold up under scrutiny. Grand Theft Auto VI is developed and published by Rockstar Games, a label owned by Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. The release date is November 19, 2026. The launch platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The standard edition costs $79.99.
Pre-orders began June 25, 2026, at midnight local time, which means players in each region saw the store pages open as their own clock rolled over. Pre-loading starts November 10, 2026, so anyone who ordered digitally can have the files on their console before launch day. Standard physical versions contain a download code and do not include a disc, per the official release information.
Take-Two describes the game as featuring “a single-player experience set in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet.” That sentence is the closest the publisher comes to a superlative. It describes the game relative to earlier entries in the series. It makes no claim about the wider entertainment industry, and that distinction matters when headlines start to stretch it.
The table below sorts the public record into what is confirmed and what is not. Treat the second column as a watch list rather than a set of facts.
The GTA 6 release date has been stable in the official materials, and that consistency counts for something. Players have had months to plan around November 19. The only dated checkpoint left before launch is the preload window opening on November 10, and the three confirmed dates run in order: pre-orders on June 25, preload on November 10, launch on November 19.
Pre-loading is more than a convenience. When a download of this scale opens, network providers, console storefronts and publishers all see a demand spike days before the game even unlocks. A staggered preload spreads that load across the nine days before launch instead of concentrating it on the morning of November 19. Players who wait until launch day to start downloading take on avoidable risk.
Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has published an official install size in the sources available to us. Numbers are circulating anyway, and they come from leaks. Until the storefronts show a size on the pre-load page, plan for a large download and free up space rather than trusting any single figure.
A $79.99 standard edition is a premium price for a console game, and it shows how much confidence Take-Two has in this title. Publishers rarely push a price up on a game they expect to struggle. Setting the number at $79.99 is a bet that demand will absorb it.
That bet has consequences beyond this one title. If buyers pay $79.99 without visible resistance, other publishers will read the result as permission to move their own flagship prices up. GTA La police attend GTA 6 avec impatience pour une raison insolite par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 09 nov. 2026, 15:30 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6 , les joueurs ne sont visiblement pas les seuls à compter les heures. Et contrairement aux millions de fans qui rêvent de découvrir Vice City , les policiers espèrent surtout que GTA 6 incitera davantage de personnes à rester chez elles, leur offrant ainsi un peu de répit.

GTA 6 needs to hurry up and get here so y'all can stay at home and let us catch a break.

articles.txt:
PlayStation 5 database discoveries suggest Rockstar is preparing GTA 6 Online, but could its PC release be part of the plan?
Grand Theft Auto 6 is almost here, but Rockstar Games still hasn't said much about what comes after its single-player campaign. That could be about to change, though, as discoveries in the game's PlayStation version suggest that work on GTA 6 Online is already underway.
This comes from ' PlayStation Game Size ', an account known for tracking PlayStation database updates and uncovering game information ahead of official announcements. In its latest findings, it identifies three multiplayer-related entries associated with GTA 6 : 'joinSession', 'launchActivity', and 'launchMultiplayerActivity'.
While that's encouraging for anyone anticipating the next evolution of GTA Online, it doesn't confirm that the mode will be available alongside the November 19 launch, or tell us when Rockstar plans to introduce it. Dataminer ' TexFunz2 ' claims that GTA 6's single-player and online components could be installed separately.
If that's accurate, players might eventually be able to remove the campaign while keeping the multiplayer experience installed, which would be particularly useful given the game's reported 210GB download size.
So, where does that leave the PC version? Rockstar hasn't officially announced one, but a recent report from GamesBeat cites four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans, claiming that it's targeting the first quarter of 2027. That would put the PC release just a few months after the console launch, a considerable improvement on GTA 5's PC port, which arrived around 19 months after its original release.
It's worth remembering that GTA Online originally launched two weeks after GTA 5 in October 2013, while Red Dead Online arrived roughly a month after Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar could take a different approach this time, considering that GTA 5's multiplayer was particularly rough at launch. Let's hope history doesn't repeat itself here.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une fuite dévoile le nombre de trophées, dix jours avant la sortie
articles.chapeau: Dix jours avant la sortie, les fichiers des plateformes ont parlé : 55 trophées au lancement, dont une énigme à 1 000 points. Rockstar, fidèle à son silence, n'a rien confirmé.
articles.txt:
Dix jours avant la sortie, les fichiers des plateformes ont parlé : 55 trophées au lancement, dont une énigme à 1 000 points. Rockstar, fidèle à son silence, n’a rien confirmé.
Rockstar verrouille la communication autour de GTA 6 depuis des années, malgré les fuites massives qui ont émaillé son développement. La liste des trophées vient pourtant de sortir par la bande, repérée dans les fichiers des plateformes de Sony et de Microsoft.
Le jeu arriverait avec 55 trophées sur PS5, platine attendue comprise, et autant de succès sur Xbox Series. Les deux plateformes racontent la même chose chacune de leur côté, ce qui donne du poids à l’extraction sans la confirmer. L’auteur du relevé a volontairement tu les noms, pour ne rien divulgâcher de l’histoire. À titre de comparaison, GTA 5 s’était lancé avec 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 trophées sur PS3, Red Dead Redemption 2 avec 51 et 52. Le nouveau venu dépasserait donc ses aînés, d’une courte tête.
Sur Xbox, un jeu répartit d’ordinaire ses 1 000 points de score entre des dizaines de succès. La liste extraite aligne ici 54 entrées modestes, échelonnées de 1 à 54 points, auxquelles s’ajoute une entrée unique créditée de 1 000 points . Deux lectures circulent : un succès « mythique » , distinction rare que Microsoft réserve aux exploits hors norme, ou une valeur provisoire posée pour les tests internes. Une capture douteuse évoquait d’ailleurs 58 trophées l’an dernier ; ces chiffres extraits avant l’heure bougent parfois d’ici au lancement.
Impossible, à ce stade, de savoir si la liste couvre le seul mode histoire ou si le volet en ligne y prendra part plus tard. Rien ne dit non plus que tout sera décrochable dès le lancement. Le décompte renseigne de toute façon assez mal sur l’ampleur ou la difficulté réelles d’un jeu. Red Dead Redemption 2 et ses 52 trophées passent encore pour un platine particulièrement redouté.
Le préchargement ouvre comme prévu le 10 novembre à minuit sur PS5 et vers 1 heure du matin en France sur Xbox Series, avec un téléchargement qui grimpe jusqu’à 212 Go suivant la machine. Les acheteurs de versions en boîte devront patienter jusqu’au 12 novembre pour récupérer leurs codes chez les revendeurs. La sortie reste calée au 19 novembre sur les deux consoles , à 79,99 euros en édition standard et 99,99 euros pour l’Ultimate numérique ; le déverrouillage à minuit demeure officieux.

La liste des trophées s’ajoute ainsi aux 25 minutes d’images de jeu parties dans la nature début octobre, dans l’indifférence publique du studio. Rockstar a bien confirmé, début novembre, les modalités du préchargement et le poids du téléchargement ; sur les trophées, silence complet. Rien ne garantit, d’ailleurs, que les valeurs repérées tiendront jusqu’au 19 novembre. Pour le joueur, le vrai rendez-vous reste la nuit du 10 : 212 Go à faire passer avant la ruée.

articles.txt:
Despite the GTA 6 release date being close, PS5 Pro perks remain unclear. However, datamining of the preload build has uncovered some performance details. The Rockstar game should offer a 120Hz refresh rate mode, hinting at a 40 fps option. A new version of PSSR 2 is also likely, but the base console may not benefit from QSSR upscaling .
Leading up to its launch, fans have debated what benefits the GTA 6 PS5 Pro upgrade would bring. On GTAForums , Tex2 leaked findings that include signs of a 120Hz toggle. On the other hand, VRR isn't supported, which in many enhanced games points to a 40 fps setting.
PSSR 2 is AI-powered upscaling that produces sharper visuals even when a title renders at a lower native resolution. The GTA 6 PS5 Pro version appears to have a refresh of the technology not seen before.
Unfortunately, the base console may not share the same advantage. Sony introduced QSSR on October 1st as an alternative to the flagship system’s PSSR. articles.t: Nouvelle fuite de données sur GTA 6 — fonctions en ligne, taille exacte et bien plus encore
GTA 6 Online : une fuite à 10 jours de la sortie révèle 3 indices majeurs sur le multijoueur
articles.chapeau: À dix jours du lancement de GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox Series, une datamine de la build de sortie met en ébullition la communauté. Trois signaux précis sur le futur GTA 6 Online relancent les spéculations sans que Rockstar ne confirme quoi que ce soit.
articles.txt:
À dix jours du lancement de GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox Series, une datamine de la build de sortie met en ébullition la communauté. Trois signaux précis sur le futur GTA 6 Online relancent les spéculations sans que Rockstar ne confirme quoi que ce soit.
Rockstar Games s’apprête à lancer Grand Theft Auto VI le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S , avec un jeu officiellement présenté comme « solo uniquement » au lancement. Les fiches du PlayStation Store indiquent clairement « 1 joueur » et un mode hors ligne, sans mention de GTA 6 Online.
Mais alors que le préchargement numérique doit débuter le 10 novembre à minuit heure locale, une fuite de la build de sortie sur l’écosystème PlayStation fait monter la pression. À 10 jours de la sortie, trois indices concrets surgissent sur le futur GTA 6 Online .
Le dataminer PlayStation Game Size , spécialiste des fichiers PS Store, a inspecté la build PS5 liée à la date de sortie. Il y a repéré des références backend explicites à trois « intentType » : « joinSession », « launchActivity » et « launchMultiplayerActivity ».
Concrètement, ces chaînes suggèrent la capacité de créer ou rejoindre des sessions, de lancer des activités instanciées et surtout des activités marquées comme multijoueur. Signe fort, ces hooks sont présents dans la build de sortie, pas dans une version de test interne. Officiellement, aucun mode online ne sera accessible le 19 novembre, mais Rockstar semble avoir préparé le terrain pour ajouter un composant multijoueur de façon quasi plug and play via une future mise à jour.
La fuite de la build PS5 fait écho à d’autres documents déjà sortis. Lors d’un litige impliquant Rockstar Games , des logs Discord mentionnaient une session de test multijoueur à 32 participants en octobre 2025. Des articles récents cités par Dexerto évoquent également un multijoueur GTA 6 à 32 joueurs , avec un studio qui décrirait en interne GTA 6 Online comme un « closely guarded secret », selon Dexerto.
Si ce plafond de 32 joueurs se confirme, il serait dans la lignée de GTA Online tout en offrant plus de marge pour des activités coopératives denses et du roleplay. Le rachat de Cfx.re , l’équipe derrière les serveurs roleplay FiveM, indique déjà que Rockstar veut encadrer officiellement ces usages dans GTA 6. Pour les joueurs, cela pourrait se traduire par des lobbys plus vivants, pensés dès le départ pour des serveurs thématiques très peuplés.
Historiquement, Rockstar n’a pas attendu des années pour activer le online. Avec GTA 5 , GTA Online est arrivé environ deux semaines après la campagne solo. Red Dead Redemption 2 a, lui, accueilli la bêta de Red Dead Online environ un mois plus tard. Ce passé laisse penser à un déploiement relativement rapproché pour GTA 6 Online.
Pourtant, le journaliste Jason Schreier a déjà prévenu que les fans pourraient devoir attendre jusqu’en 2027 pour de vraies missions coopératives, et le PDG de Twitch , Dan Clancy , estime qu’un lancement de GTA 6 Online en 2027 provoquerait un pic d’audience massif. Entre ces prévisions prudentes et une build de sortie déjà truffée d’appels multijoueur, le message est clair : rien n’est officiel, mais Rockstar prépare déjà le socle technique. À l’approche du préchargement du 10 novembre, les dataminers sont en alerte et d’autres indices sur GTA 6 Online pourraient tomber très vite.

articles.t: GTA 6's online mode looks set for 2027 as dataminers unearth early features
articles.chapeau: When the wait for GTA 6 is over, the wait for GTA 6 Online begins!
articles.txt:
GTA 6's online mode is still shrouded in secrecy, but fresh leaks are giving us an idea of what to expect.
Grand Theft Auto VI finally releases later this month after years in the making, plus a lot of leaks.
Even with the launch day in sight though, the leaks aren’t stopping yet, and they’re now shifting to what comes after GTA VI drops on consoles: the online mode.
There’s been a lot of speculation on what the future of GTA: Online could look like, and judging from Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2 , it’ll likely be another standalone project.
However, it’ll obviously integrate with GTA VI, as PlayStation Game Size discovered the phrases: “joinSession", "launchActivity" and "launchMultiplayerActivity" in the game’s code.
These backends are, obviously, related to multiplayer activities, so it sounds like Rockstar Games is already actively working on the online mode’s launch. It makes sense considering the base game should be ready to go live by now.
The question now is when it will launch and what kind of content we should expect. GTA: Online was pretty barebones when it launched back in 2013, but over time it blossomed into a bustling metropolis of in-game activities and regular content updates.
If GTA VI’s open-world is as large as the leaks say, there’ll need to be plenty for players to do to keep them interested.
READ NEXT: GTA 6 prompts US internet provider to offer free upgrade to improve launch day download speed
Interestingly, PlayStation isn’t the only platform with clues relating to GTA VI’s online mode, as the Rockstar Games Launcher has received some ominous updates too.
Reddit user u/Alone-Voice8517 spotted the launcher had been revamped with new features and improvements for online play for those on PC, and naturally assumed that it has something to do with GTA VI .
Some of the comments argued that Rockstar is merely improving the online experience for roleplayers on GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 , but there’s no reason that both theories can’t be true.
Reading between the lines, it feels safe to speculate that Rockstar is gearing up for a simultaneous launch of both the PC port and the next iteration of GTA: Online .
Again, it makes sense considering Rockstar did the exact same thing for GTA V . The Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 versions launched first, and the PC port was released on the same day GTA: Online went live.
As stated earlier, GTA: Online has been out for years now and during that time players will have likely amassed a wealth of in-game cash, vehicles, weapons and more.
There’s been some speculation on what, if any, loot can be carried over to GTA: Online and while Rockstar is yet to shed some light on the situation, it’s likely that all players will have to start from scratch.
However, Rockstar Games is a studio that often rewards player loyalty and retention, so while you probably won’t be able to transfer anything across to GTA VI , you might get some bonuses if you’ve got your Rockstar Games Account linked to your game.
If you’ve somehow not done that already, we’d advise you to do so before GTA VI launches.

articles.t: GTA 6 Multiplayer Leak: 3 Online Strings Found [2026]
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 multiplayer leak: 3 online strings reportedly found in the launch build. What is confirmed, what is rumor, and what to expect on Nov. 19.
articles.txt:
A new datamining report says the build of Grand Theft Auto VI intended for launch carries code that points to multiplayer features. Notebookcheck published the story on November 9, 2026, citing the account PlayStation Game Size, which says it found joinSession , launchActivity and launchMultiplayerActivity in PlayStation’s backend data. The game itself is set to launch on November 19, 2026 , ten days from today.
The headline claim circulating online is that a GTA 6 online multiplayer mode could arrive soon. The evidence is thinner than the headline. Mezha.net, which relayed the Notebookcheck report, states plainly that the mode will not be available on November 19, and that a successor to GTA Online could still sit months away. This analysis separates what Rockstar and its partners have confirmed from what leakers and outlets have reported, and it explains why the gap matters for players and for Take-Two Interactive.
The timing is not random. Preloads are due to begin first in New Zealand at midnight local time on November 10, according to Notebookcheck, and every preloaded file gives data miners a new surface to inspect. We already tracked the earlier size leaks in our coverage of the Xbox file size figures of 209.86 GB and 225.34 GB , and this latest find follows the same pattern: backend metadata surfaces first, interpretation follows, and official confirmation lags behind both.
